answer: At the wharf, every identity locks a key-bound willow token and a 70-credit bond. At a beacon minute, all cross the willow bridge showing tokens within 60 seconds. Auditors replay the bridge log on the wharf registry: a miss, reuse or double burns the bond. First costs 40, the k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 40 once, and a rented-crossing ring fails: one body cannot cross a thousand times in 60s.
